chunks: Except those of the right hand

key_terms.الْيَمِينِ: The right (hand), symbolizing success and honor

ai.seo_question: Who are the Companions of the Right in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the 'Aṣḥāb al-Yamīn' as those who attain salvation through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and righteous deeds, distinguishing them from the 'Aṣḥāb al-Shimāl' who face ruin. The 'right hand' symbolizes divine acceptance and ease in receiving one's record, a concept deeply tied to the dualistic eschatology found in Surah al-Muddaththir. This classification underscores the ultimate fate of believers who align themselves with the path of truth and guidance.
